Why do bettors from far and wide flock to Bovada to bet on March Madness, UFC events, NFL odds, and much more? Read our in-depth review to find out.

Does Bovada Sportsbook Have a Signup Bonus?

Whether you like to bet on sports or play blackjack, roulette, or other popular online casino games at top online casinos, there is a good chance you have taken at least a bonus or two.

Many of the best sports betting sites are popular because of the welcome bonuses and promotions that they offer, and that includes Bovada.

There are two Bovada sportsbook welcome bonuses, one for players who prefer to deposit via credit card and one for players who prefer to use cryptocurrency for online gambling.

If you sign up there and use a Visa or Mastercard to make your first deposit, you can receive a 50% bonus up to $250.

But if you use Bitcoin, Tether, or another cryptocurrency to make your first Bovada deposit, you can receive a 75% bonus up to $750.

A higher bonus is not the only benefit if you deposit with crypto at Bovada. If that is your preferred banking method, you can upgrade your account (for free) and unlock special rewards with a Premium Crypto-Exclusive Membership. This membership grants you access to extra rewards and bonuses that you will not receive if you deposit with other methods, including weekly bonuses.

What Features Does Bovada Sportsbook Offer?

Bovada is one of the longest running and most popular sports betting sites available. Operating out of Antigua, it has been in the industry since 2011 and has been a leader in safety, security and onsite features since its inception.

Whether your focus is major events such as the FIFA World Cup, making futures bets, or betting on NBA odds, MLB odds, or NHL odds throughout the week, Bovada offers a range of fantastic features for all your sports betting needs:

Bonuses and Rewards: Take advantage of a range of Bovada bonuses and promotions for new and active players.

Huge Selection of Betting Options: Bet on everything from college football odds, NBA player props, the Masters and other major and minor golf tournaments, to niche betting markets such as the CFL or international basketball and soccer leagues.

Quick Deposit and Withdrawals: Bovada deposits and withdrawals are easy, efficient, and secure.

Great Customer Service: There’s nothing more important than knowing you are in safe hands when gambling. Their customer service is always available to answer your questions and solve any issues.

Also, unlike many other U.S. betting sites, Bovada offers the option to cash out early on your bets. That means that if your confidence in a wager wanes before kickoff, tip-off, or first pitch, you can back out of it. Or, if you don’t want to sweat out a live bet during a close game, you can quit while you are ahead and ensure you don’t come up empty-handed if the final result doesn’t go your way.

What Are Bovada Sportsbook’s Betting Options?

Few online sportsbooks can match Bovada when it comes to betting options.

Plenty of bettors in the U.S. focus only on football (NFL and college football), basketball (NBA, WNBA, and college basketball), baseball (MLB), and hockey (NHL).

But for those looking beyond the major American sports and leagues, Bovada has it all. Whether you want to bet on Formula 1, the top soccer matchups this week, the Rugby World Cup, or the Winter Olympics, you can do so there with ease.

Here is a rundown of the betting options available at Bovada:

  • Basketball
  • Tennis
  • Baseball
  • Boxing
  • Motorsports
  • Rugby union
  • Rugby league
  • Australian rules football
  • Cycling
  • Handball
  • Table tennis
  • Hockey

  • Football

  • Volleyball
  • Entertainment
  • Winter sports
  • Soccer
  • Golf
  • Cricket
  • Horse racing
  • Darts
  • Futsal
  • Olympics & Olympic sports

That many options may seem overwhelming, but the user-friendly layout of Bovada’s site on desktop or mobile devices enables bettors to navigate through the options and find the right bets and events without confusion.

What Other Sportsbook Bonuses and Promotions Does Bovada Have?

Bovada Parlay Booster

Get more from your bets with Parlay Booster! Each day, you can earn Reward Points by wagering on select boosted parlay odds. Place a boosted parlay bet each week, and you will automatically be entered into the Weekly Reward Points Prize Draw.

How to Qualify:

  • Deposit at least $10 within the past 7 days.
  • Place at least one wager on a boosted parlay within the past 7 days.

Every Monday, 1,000 eligible wagers are randomly selected for the draw. Winners will be notified via inbox message within 48 hours.

If selected, your Reward Points from boosted parlay wagers in the previous week will be doubled, up to a maximum of 1,000 points per week. Better yet, you can win multiple times if you are lucky in the weekly draws.

The more you bet, the more chances you have to rack up points and redeem them in the Reward Store for bonuses that boost your play. With Parlay Booster, you get better odds, extra points, and more rewards.

Same Game Parlays

Bovada now features Same Game Parlays. This is your opportunity to make every game count with player prop lines and by betting on player stats. This is currently available for NBA game picks and NFL game picks, but available markets will expand.

Build your SGP your way with up to six unique picks, with the option to choose from sides (moneyline and spread bets), game and team totals (over/under bets), player props, and more.

Does Bovada Have a Rewards Program?

Yes, Bovada has a rewards program. By having a Bovada account, you are automatically a member of the rewards program at Bovada.

Through real money sportsbook, Bovada Casino, Bovada Racebook, and Bovada Poker activity, you will earn Reward Points. These points will help you advance through the tiers of the program and can be redeemed for cash bonuses and poker tournament tickets.

There is no limit to how many points you can rack up, so this program can be especially rewarding for those who like to gamble in different ways. Whether you like to regularly bet on WNBA odds, play blackjack and other popular online casino games, or wager on the Kentucky Derby and other major horse races, you can rack up some serious points.

What Are Bovada Sportsbook’s Banking Options?

For bettors who prefer to use traditional banking methods for making deposits and receiving payouts, Bovada’s deposit and withdrawal options include the option to use bank wire or check.

These days, however, crypto sportsbooks and crypto casinos are all the rage, and offering a variety of crypto deposit and withdrawals options is imperative to keep up with the competition.

Bovada does just that, offering deposits and withdrawals in Bitcoin, Bitcoin Cash, Bitcoin SV, Ethereum, Litecoin, and Tether (USDT).

Mobile Betting at Bovada

Along with offering a variety of crypto payment methods, sports betting sites and real money online casinos these days must be accessible on mobile devices, whether through a mobile-optimized site or a dedicated mobile app.

Bovada ticks that box with flying colors as well, as their site is optimized for smooth use on computers, smartphones, and tablets. So, whether you are watching the big game from the comfort of your couch, out and about with friends, or at a game in person, you can place the wagers you want at Bovada.

Is Bovada a Secure Site?

From a security standpoint, Bovada prides itself on its on-site security. Bovada is a trusted name in the online sports betting industry. You can rest assured that your banking information will be safe in their hands.

They have high-tech security features that keep you and your information protected. They also run site updates very often to ensure that none of your information is ever compromised.

Where Is Bovada Available?

Can you play at Bovada where you live? It is available in 32 of the 50 U.S. states, so many U.S. bettors are able to place bets, make deposits, and receive payouts there.

However, residents in the following states, as well as the District of Columbia, are unable to do so:

  • Arizona
  • Colorado
  • Connecticut
  • Delaware
  • District of Columbia
  • Kansas
  • Louisiana
  • Maryland
  • Massachusetts
  • Michigan
  • Nevada
  • New Hampshire
  • New Jersey
  • New York
  • Ohio
  • Pennsylvania
  • Tennessee
  • West Virginia

If you live in any of these places, we recommend checking out our other sportsbook reviews to find out which betting sites you can use where you are.

But if you reside in California, Florida, and Texas, the three most populous states and home to some of the most well-known names and teams in sports, you can bet on your favorite teams at Bovada.

So, whether you want to bet on the Dallas Cowboys to win the Super Bowl, the Los Angeles Lakers to win the NBA Finals, the Los Angeles Dodgers to win the World Series, or the Tampa Bay Lightning to win the Stanley Cup, you can do so at Bovada if you reside in those respective states.

Why Should You Use Bovada?

Quite simply, Bovada is one of the best sports betting sites you will find. Its longevity in the industry comes down to consistently providing a rewarding experience for bettors of all interest and experience levels, and its status as one of the top online sportsbooks should remain intact for years to come.

Players can bet on major and niche sports and events with no hassle on both computers and mobile devices. Additionally, Bovada offers a robust live betting platform that allows bettors to keep up with the action in real time on both computers and mobile devices.

Deposits and withdrawals are also stress-free at Bovada, and along with their generous sign-up bonuses for both crypto and non-crypto deposits, Bovada has one of the best rewards programs in the industry, and the Premium Crypto-Exclusive Membership gives users another compelling reason to keep coming back.

Also, Bovada is committed to protecting players and promoting responsible gambling, so if you ever find yourself needing to take a short or extended break, support is a quick call, email, or message away.

Conclusion

Bovada’s long-standing reputation as a top-tier sportsbook is well-earned, thanks to its extensive betting options, user-friendly platform, and generous bonuses.

With secure banking methods, a seamless mobile experience, and a commitment to customer satisfaction, it continues to be a preferred destination for bettors of all levels.

Whether you are looking for competitive odds, live betting opportunities, or crypto-friendly transactions, Bovada delivers on all fronts. If you are searching for a reliable sportsbook with a strong track record, Bovada remains a top choice in 2026.

Bovada Sportsbook FAQ

Is Bovada a safe and secure sportsbook?
Yes, Bovada is a well-established and reputable sportsbook with strong security measures to protect user data and transactions. It has been a trusted name in the industry since 2011, providing a secure and fair betting experience.
How can I deposit at Bovada?
Bovada accepts traditional payment methods like credit cards and bank transfers, as well as cryptocurrencies such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Litecoin. Crypto deposits offer additional benefits, including faster processing times and exclusive promotions.
Where is Bovada available?
Bovada is available in 32 U.S. states but is restricted in others, including New York, New Jersey, and Pennsylvania. If you’re unsure whether you can access Bovada from your location, check their website or explore other sportsbooks that operate in your state.
Does Bovada offer live betting?
Yes, Bovada has a robust live betting platform that allows users to place wagers on games as they happen. The interface is designed for seamless navigation, providing real-time odds updates and cash-out options to enhance the live betting experience.
How do bonuses work at Bovada?
Bovada offers a variety of welcome and ongoing bonuses, with higher percentage matches for crypto deposits. Bonus funds are subject to wagering requirements, meaning you must bet a certain amount before withdrawing winnings. Always check the terms before claiming a bonus.
